no_save_personal_info.what: Probably a legacy 'public computer' flag telling the client not to persist personal/account information on this machine; stored in config.vdf and read by steamclient, with no UI in this build.

preferred_monitor.what: Which monitor Big Picture Mode opens on (monitor identifier string). Written via the dedicated SteamClient.Settings.SetPreferredMonitor API, not the generic setter.
preferred_monitor.ui: Big Picture Settings > Display (monitor selector), via dedicated API

steam_cef_gpu_blocklist_disabled.what: When true, the Steam web views (CEF/Chromium) ignore Chromium's GPU driver blocklist so GPU acceleration is used even on blocklisted drivers. Takes effect after restarting Steam.
steam_cef_gpu_blocklist_disabled.ui: 'Disable GPU Blocklist' - Settings > Interface (advanced), requires restart

bigpicture_windowed.what: Runs Big Picture Mode in a window instead of fullscreen. Available before login; set through SteamClient.Settings.SetWindowed.
bigpicture_windowed.ui: Big Picture display options (dedicated API); not a generic settings control

display_name.what: Read-only state: name of the display the Steam UI is currently on (used by the display/scaling UI).
display_name.ui: not shown in UI (state used by the Display page)

is_external_display.what: Read-only state: whether the current display is an external monitor rather than the built-in panel (e.g. Steam Deck docked).

steam_os_underscan_level.what: SteamOS underscan amount (float) that shrinks the picture to compensate for TV overscan; only meaningful while underscan is enabled.
steam_os_underscan_level.ui: Big Picture/SteamOS Settings > Display > Underscan (read via legacy settings object)

steam_os_underscan_enabled.what: Enables SteamOS display underscan (shrinking the image so its edges are not cut off on TVs that overscan).
steam_os_underscan_enabled.ui: Big Picture/SteamOS Settings > Display > Underscan (read via legacy settings object)

min_scale_factor.what: Read-only state: smallest UI scale factor allowed for the current display; bounds the scaling slider.
min_scale_factor.ui: not shown in UI (bounds the Display > Scaling slider)

max_scale_factor.what: Read-only state: largest UI scale factor allowed for the current display; bounds the scaling slider.
max_scale_factor.ui: not shown in UI (bounds the Display > Scaling slider)

auto_scale_factor.what: Read-only state: the scale factor Steam picks automatically for the current display when 'auto' scaling is used.
auto_scale_factor.ui: not shown in UI (used by Display > Scaling)

small_mode.what: Desktop library 'Small Mode' (compact game list without the large library view). The client switches it off automatically when it needs to show a page in the main window.
small_mode.ui: Desktop client menu View > Small Mode

skip_steamvr_install_dialog.what: Suppresses the 'install SteamVR' prompt shown when a VR headset is detected (stored as system\SteamVRHMDVGUIWarning).
skip_steamvr_install_dialog.ui: 'Don't Show this dialog again' checkbox on the SteamVR install dialog

always_show_user_chooser.what: When enabled, Steam shows the account picker at every start instead of logging in the remembered account automatically.
always_show_user_chooser.ui: 'Ask which account to use each time Steam starts' - Settings > Interface / account switcher

os_version_unsupported.what: Probably a flag the client sets when the running OS version is no longer supported, used to show an unsupported-OS warning.

show_family_sharing_notifications.what: Probably controls notifications related to Steam Family / Family Sharing activity; computed by the client, no UI reference in this build.

show_copy_count_in_library.what: Shows how many copies of a game the Steam Family owns in the library (default on).
show_copy_count_in_library.ui: 'Show number of copies in Steam Family library' - Settings > Library

overlay_fps_counter_corner.what: Position of the in-game performance monitor/FPS counter: Off, Top-left, Top-center, Top-right, Bottom-right, Bottom-center or Bottom-left (Off disables it; other perf-overlay options appear only when it is not Off).
overlay_fps_counter_corner.ui: 'Show performance monitor' dropdown - Settings > In Game; also Steam Deck QAM Performance

overlay_fps_counter_high_contrast.what: Draws the FPS counter in a high-contrast style for readability.
overlay_fps_counter_high_contrast.ui: 'FPS High Contrast' - Big Picture/Steam Deck QAM > Performance

overlay_key.what: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Steam Overlay in game (default Shift+Tab).

screenshot_key.what: Keyboard shortcut that takes a Steam screenshot in game (default F12).
screenshot_key.ui: 'Take a screenshot' shortcut - Settings > In Game > Screenshots

enable_overlay.what: Master switch for the Steam Overlay in games (default on); when off, the overlay and features relying on it are unavailable in-game.
enable_overlay.ui: 'Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game' - Settings > In Game

enable_screenshot_notification.what: Shows a notification toast when a screenshot is taken (default on).
enable_screenshot_notification.ui: 'When a screenshot is taken, display a notification' - Settings > In Game > Screenshots

enable_screenshot_sound.what: Plays a sound when a screenshot is taken (default on).
enable_screenshot_sound.ui: 'When a screenshot is taken, play a sound' - Settings > In Game > Screenshots

save_uncompressed_screenshots.what: Also saves an external (uncompressed/lossless) copy of each screenshot to the screenshot folder in addition to Steam's JPEG copy.
save_uncompressed_screenshots.ui: 'Save an external copy of my screenshots' - Settings > In Game > Screenshots

screenshots_path.what: Folder where external screenshot copies are saved; computed/forwarded to the screenshot manager.
screenshots_path.ui: Screenshot folder picker - Settings > In Game > Screenshots

default_ping_rate.what: Read-only: the automatic server-browser ping rate the client computed from network speed; shown as 'Automatic (N)' in the ping-rate dropdown.
default_ping_rate.ui: Shown as the 'Automatic (%s)' option of 'Server browser pings/minute' - Settings > In Game

server_ping_rate.what: Server browser pings per minute: Automatic or a fixed 5000/3000/1500/1000/500/250. Lower it if browsing game servers causes connection problems.

steam_networking_share_ip.what: Whether games using Steam Networking may share your IP address for a faster (direct) connection: Default, Never, Friends Only, or Always.

web_browser_home.what: Home page URL for the Steam Overlay web browser.
web_browser_home.ui: 'Web browser home page' - Settings > In Game

voice_mic_device_name.what: Name of the microphone device Steam voice chat uses (forwarded to the voice subsystem).

voice_mic_input_gain.what: Microphone input volume/gain for Steam voice (float, forwarded to the voice subsystem).

voice_speaker_output_gain.what: Output volume/gain for incoming Steam voice audio (float).

voice_push_to_talk_setting.what: Probably the voice transmit mode (e.g. open mic vs. push-to-talk/mute) for in-game Steam voice; no JS reference in this build.
voice_push_to_talk_setting.ui: not shown in UI (generic setting); voice UI uses friends settings

voice_push_to_talk_key.what: Probably the push-to-talk hotkey for in-game Steam voice; no JS reference in this build.

overlay_toolbar_list_view.what: Shows the Steam Overlay toolbar as a list view instead of icons.
overlay_toolbar_list_view.ui: 'Show toolbar as list view' - Settings > In Game > Toolbar preferences

always_use_gamepadui_overlay.what: Uses the Big Picture (gamepad) overlay instead of the desktop overlay when playing with a controller.
always_use_gamepadui_overlay.ui: 'Use the Big Picture Overlay when using a controller' - Settings > In Game

overlay_tabs.what: JSON array of {window, visible} entries that sets which overlay toolbar tabs (e.g. GameServers, Timeline) are shown and in what order; roams across machines.
overlay_tabs.ui: Overlay toolbar preferences (Settings > In Game > Toolbar preferences / overlay toolbar)

overlay_scale_interface.what: Scales Steam Overlay text and icons to match the monitor's DPI scaling (default on).
overlay_scale_interface.ui: 'Scale Steam Overlay text and icons to match monitor settings' - Settings > In Game

overlay_restore_browser_tabs.what: Reopens the overlay web browser's previous tabs when a game starts (default on).
overlay_restore_browser_tabs.ui: 'Restore my previous browser tabs when starting a game' - Settings > In Game

enable_avif_screenshots.what: Saves external copies of HDR screenshots as AVIF files.
enable_avif_screenshots.ui: 'Save external HDR screenshots as AVIF' - Settings > In Game > Screenshots

overlay_fps_counter_detail_level.what: Amount of detail in the performance monitor: FPS Single Value, FPS Details, FPS Details + CPU & GPU Utilization, or FPS/CPU/GPU/RAM Full Details (default 1 = simplest). Graph options appear only at higher levels.
overlay_fps_counter_detail_level.ui: 'Performance detail level' - Settings > In Game (shown when performance monitor is on)

overlay_fps_counter_saturation_factor.what: Text contrast/saturation of the performance monitor (slider 0-1, step 0.1; default 1).
overlay_fps_counter_saturation_factor.ui: 'Text contrast/saturation' - Settings > In Game > Performance monitor

overlay_fps_counter_bgopacity.what: Background opacity of the performance monitor (slider 0-1, step 0.1; default 0.8).
overlay_fps_counter_bgopacity.ui: 'Background opacity' - Settings > In Game > Performance monitor

overlay_fps_counter_scale_factor.what: Text size scaling of the performance monitor (slider 0.2-1.4, step 0.1; default 0.7).
overlay_fps_counter_scale_factor.ui: 'Text size scaling' - Settings > In Game > Performance monitor

overlay_fps_counter_key.what: Hotkey that toggles the in-game performance monitor (default 'Default', i.e. unbound/built-in).
overlay_fps_counter_key.ui: 'Toggle performance monitor key(s)' - Settings > In Game > Overlay Performance Monitor

overlay_fps_counter_fps_graph.what: Shows the FPS average/minimum graph in the performance monitor (only offered at detail level above the simplest).
overlay_fps_counter_fps_graph.ui: 'Show FPS Avg/Min Graph' - Settings > In Game > Performance monitor

overlay_fps_counter_cpu_graph.what: Shows the per-core CPU utilization graph in the performance monitor (offered only at the higher detail levels).
overlay_fps_counter_cpu_graph.ui: 'Show CPU Utilization Per-Core Graph' - Settings > In Game > Performance monitor

overlay_fps_counter_allow_km_driver.what: Allows the performance monitor to use a kernel-mode driver on Windows for extra metrics such as CPU temperature (default on).
overlay_fps_counter_allow_km_driver.ui: 'Enable kernel driver based metrics (CPU Temperature)' - Settings > In Game (Windows)

achievement_notification_toast.what: Shows a toast when you unlock an achievement (default on).
achievement_notification_toast.ui: Toast checkbox for the achievement-unlocked row - Settings > Notifications

achievement_notification_sound.what: Plays a sound when you unlock an achievement (default on).
achievement_notification_sound.ui: Sound checkbox for the achievement-unlocked row - Settings > Notifications

controllerconnect_notification_toast.what: Shows a toast when a controller connects (default on).
controllerconnect_notification_toast.ui: Toast checkbox for the controller-connected row - Settings > Notifications

controllerconnect_notification_sound.what: Plays a sound when a controller connects (default off).
controllerconnect_notification_sound.ui: Sound checkbox for the controller-connected row - Settings > Notifications

controller_low_battery_notification_toas.what: Shows a toast when a controller's battery is low (default on).
controller_low_battery_notification_toas.ui: Toast checkbox for the controller-low-battery row - Settings > Notifications

controller_low_battery_notification_soun.what: Plays a sound when a controller's battery is low (default off).
controller_low_battery_notification_soun.ui: Sound checkbox for the controller-low-battery row - Settings > Notifications

logged_in_as_user_notification_toast.what: Shows a toast saying which account you are logged in as (default on).
logged_in_as_user_notification_toast.ui: Toast checkbox for the 'logged in as user' row - Settings > Notifications

logged_in_as_user_notification_sound.what: Plays a sound with the 'logged in as user' notification (default off).
logged_in_as_user_notification_sound.ui: Sound checkbox for the 'logged in as user' row - Settings > Notifications

smooth_scroll_webviews.what: Enables smooth scrolling in Steam's web views; requires a Steam restart.
smooth_scroll_webviews.ui: 'Enable smooth scrolling in web views (requires restart)' - Settings > Interface

enable_gpu_accelerated_webviews.what: Enables GPU-accelerated rendering for Steam's web views (CEF); requires restart. Game Recording reports it as required ('Requires Steam Client GPU Acceleration').
enable_gpu_accelerated_webviews.ui: 'Enable GPU accelerated rendering in web views (requires restart)' - Settings > Interface

enable_hardware_video_decoding.what: Uses hardware video decoding in Steam web views/video when supported; requires restart.
enable_hardware_video_decoding.ui: 'Enable hardware video decoding, if supported (requires restart)' - Settings > Interface

run_at_startup.what: Starts Steam automatically when you log in to the computer (computed from the OS autostart entry).
run_at_startup.ui: 'Run Steam when my computer starts' - Settings > Interface

enable_dpi_scaling.what: Scales Steam's text and icons to match the OS monitor scaling; requires restart.
enable_dpi_scaling.ui: 'Scale text and icons to match monitor settings (requires restart)' - Settings > Interface

enable_marketing_messages.what: Allows notifications about additions/changes to your games, new releases and upcoming releases (default on).
enable_marketing_messages.ui: 'Notify me about additions or changes to my games, new releases, and upcoming releases' - Settings > Interface

start_in_big_picture_mode.what: Starts Steam directly in Big Picture Mode (on SteamOS: when in Desktop Mode).
start_in_big_picture_mode.ui: 'Start Steam in Big Picture Mode' (SteamOS: '...when in Desktop Mode') - Settings > Interface

jumplist_flags.what: Bitmask of entries shown in the Windows taskbar jump list / tray menu (status Online/Away/Invisible/Offline plus Store, Library, Community, Friends, Screenshots, Servers, Settings, Big Picture, SteamVR, Exit, etc.); default 77680.

enable_ui_sounds.what: Plays Steam UI navigation sounds (default on).
enable_ui_sounds.ui: 'Enable UI sounds' - Settings > Audio (Big Picture/Steam Deck)

enable_gamescope_composer.what: Developer option: uses gamescope to composite Steam's browser views; requires restart (default off).

enable_gamescope_composer_vr.what: Developer option: uses the gamescope browser composer in VR; requires restart (default on).
enable_gamescope_composer_vr.ui: 'Enable gamescope VR browser composer' - Settings > Developer

show_switch_to_desktop_at_login.what: On SteamOS, offers a 'Switch to Desktop' option on the login screen when no user is logged in.
show_switch_to_desktop_at_login.ui: 'Show Switch To Desktop option when not logged in' - Settings > Interface (SteamOS)

enable_steamrt64_client.what: Opts into the experimental 64-bit Steam client running in the Steam Linux Runtime 3 (steamrt64); requires restart.
enable_steamrt64_client.ui: 'Use experimental SteamRT3 Steam Client' - Settings > Interface (Linux)

disable_all_toasts.what: Together with disable_toasts_in_game drives 'Show Notification Toasts...': both false = Anytime, only in-game disabled = When I'm not in-game, this true = Never.
disable_all_toasts.ui: 'Show Notification Toasts...' dropdown (Anytime/When I'm not in-game/Never) - Settings > Notifications

disable_toasts_in_game.what: Suppresses notification toasts while a game is running ('When I'm not in-game' choice of the notification-toasts dropdown).

play_sound_on_toast.what: Plays a sound when a notification toast is shown (default on); when off, per-notification sound checkboxes are disabled.
play_sound_on_toast.ui: 'Play a sound when a notification toast is displayed' - Settings > Notifications

library_display_size.what: Size of library UI elements/capsules: Automatic, Small, Medium or Large.
library_display_size.ui: 'Display size for Library user interface elements' - Settings > Library

library_whats_new_show_only_product_upda.what: Limits the library home 'What's New' shelf to product updates (no other event types).
library_whats_new_show_only_product_upda.ui: 'Only show product updates in What's New' - Library home shelf settings

show_store_content_on_home.what: Shows personalized store content on the library home (default on).
show_store_content_on_home.ui: 'Show personalized store content on my Home' - Library home settings

start_page.what: Window/page Steam opens at startup: Store, Library, News, Friends, Friend Activity, Community Home or Servers (string value, e.g. 'library').

library_low_bandwidth_mode.what: Reduces bandwidth use by disabling features like auto-loading community content in the library.

library_low_perf_mode.what: Improves library performance by disabling some graphical effects and transitions.

library_disable_community_content.what: Stops the library game page from automatically loading community content.

library_display_icon_in_game_list.what: Shows game icons in the library's left-hand game list (default on).
library_display_icon_in_game_list.ui: 'Show game icons in the left column' - Settings > Library

ready_to_play_includes_streaming.what: Includes games streamable from another PC in the library's 'Ready to Play' filter and defaults their Play button to streaming.
ready_to_play_includes_streaming.ui: 'Ready to Play should include streamable games' - Settings > Library

show_steam_deck_info.what: Shows Steam Deck compatibility information in the library.
show_steam_deck_info.ui: 'Show Steam Deck compatibility information in library' - Settings > Library

library_home_big_art.what: Big Picture/Deck home screen alternate layout that highlights background art for the selected Recent Games title.
library_home_big_art.ui: 'Big Art Mode' - Settings > Customization (Big Picture/Steam Deck)

enable_shader_precache.what: Enables Shader Pre-caching: Steam downloads/collects precompiled shaders for your system (slightly more disk and bandwidth). The label shows the current cache size.
enable_shader_precache.ui: 'Enable Shader Pre-caching (N MB pre-cached)' - Settings > Downloads

enable_shader_background_processing.what: Allows Steam to compile/process Vulkan shaders in the background (e.g. while idle) so games start with fewer stutters.
enable_shader_background_processing.ui: 'Allow background processing of Vulkan shaders' - Settings > Downloads

shader_precached_size.what: Read-only: current size of the shader pre-cache (shown in MB in the pre-caching label).
shader_precached_size.ui: Shown inside 'Enable Shader Pre-caching (%s MB pre-cached)' - Settings > Downloads

needs_steam_service_repair.what: Probably a read-only flag indicating the Windows Steam Client Service needs repair; no JS reference in this build.

download_peer_content.what: Game File Transfer over Local Network: off (don't allow local transfers) or allow transfers to/from Only me, Steam Friends, or Anyone.
download_peer_content.ui: 'Game File Transfer over Local Network' toggle + 'Allow transfers from this device to' dropdown - Settings > Downloads

download_rate_bits_per_s.what: Displays download rates in bits per second (Kbps/Mbps) instead of bytes per second; also changes the unit of the speed-limit field.
download_rate_bits_per_s.ui: 'Display download rates in bits per second' - Settings > Downloads

restrict_auto_updates.what: Only lets automatic game updates run inside the scheduled window given by restrict_auto_updates_start/_end.

restrict_auto_updates_start.what: Start hour of the auto-update window (hour value chosen from the client-provided list of valid hours).

restrict_auto_updates_end.what: End hour of the auto-update window.

download_region.what: Content server region used for downloads (region ID from the client's region list).

download_while_app_running.what: Allows downloads to continue while a game is running.

download_throttle_while_streaming.what: Limits download speed while Remote Play streaming to keep stream quality high.

download_throttle_rate.what: Download speed limit (0 = unlimited); entered in KB/s or Kbps depending on download_rate_bits_per_s. Downloads show a throttle indicator when set.

default_app_update_behavior.what: Global default for automatic game updates used by games set to 'Use global setting': Wait until I launch the game, Let Steam decide when to update, or Immediately download updates.
default_app_update_behavior.ui: Automatic Updates default - Settings > Downloads (also referenced in game Properties > Updates)

cloud_enabled.what: Master switch for Steam Cloud synchronization of saves for supporting games (default on).

show_screenshot_manager.what: Opens the Screenshot Manager after closing a game in which screenshots were taken.

music_volume.what: Steam music player (soundtrack) volume, 0-100 in steps of 10.

music_pause_on_app_start.what: Pauses Steam music playback when an application starts.
music_pause_on_app_start.ui: 'Pause music when starting an application' - Settings > Music

music_pause_on_voice_chat.what: Pauses Steam music playback during voice chat.
music_pause_on_voice_chat.ui: 'Pause music when voice chatting' - Settings > Music

music_download_high_quality.what: Downloads high-quality audio files for soundtracks.
music_download_high_quality.ui: 'Download high quality audio files' - Settings > Music

broadcast_permissions.what: Who may watch your Steam Broadcast: 0 Disabled, 1 Friends can request to watch (approve), 2 Friends can watch without asking, 3 Anyone can watch (public), 4 subscribers (default 1).

broadcast_output_width.what: Broadcast video width in pixels; set together with broadcast_output_height by the video-dimensions dropdown.
broadcast_output_width.ui: 'Video Dimensions' dropdown (paired with height) - Settings > Broadcast

broadcast_output_height.what: Broadcast video height in pixels (default 720); chosen via the video-dimensions dropdown which also sets the width.

broadcast_bitrate.what: Maximum broadcast bitrate in kbps (default 2500), selected from a dropdown.

broadcast_encoding_option.what: Broadcast encoder preference: 0 best quality, 1 best performance.

broadcast_record_all_video.what: Captures video from all applications/the desktop rather than only the game while broadcasting.
broadcast_record_all_video.ui: 'Record video from all applications on this machine' - Settings > Broadcast

broadcast_record_all_audio.what: Captures audio from all applications on the machine while broadcasting.
broadcast_record_all_audio.ui: 'Record audio from all applications on this machine' - Settings > Broadcast

broadcast_record_microphone.what: Includes your microphone in the broadcast.

broadcast_show_upload_stats.what: Shows broadcast upload statistics (debug info) in game.

broadcast_show_live_reminder.what: Always shows the 'Live' indicator in game while broadcasting (default on).

broadcast_chat_corner.what: Screen corner where viewers' chat is shown in game, using the same Off/Top-left/Top-center/Top-right/Bottom-right/Bottom-center/Bottom-left choices as the performance monitor (default 1).
broadcast_chat_corner.ui: 'Show viewers' chat in game' - Settings > Broadcast

gamestream_hardware_video_encode.what: Uses GPU hardware video encoding for game recording/streaming (default on).
gamestream_hardware_video_encode.ui: 'Enable GPU hardware encoding' - Settings > Game Recording

gamestream_enable_video_h265.what: Allows the HEVC (H.265) codec for game recording/streaming video (default on).
gamestream_enable_video_h265.ui: 'Enable HEVC (H.265) video codec' - Settings > Game Recording

steam_input_configurator_error_msg_enabl.what: Steam Input layout dev mode: shows developer menu options and parse-error popups in the controller configurator; requires restart.
steam_input_configurator_error_msg_enabl.ui: 'Steam Input Layout Dev Mode' - Settings > Developer

controller_guide_button_focus_steam.what: Pressing the controller Guide/Steam button brings Steam (Big Picture) to the foreground (default on).

controller_ps_support.what: Steam Input for PlayStation controllers: Not Enabled, Enabled in Games w/o Support (value 1, default), or Enabled (value 2).

controller_xbox_support.what: Enables Steam Input (remapping/configurations) for Xbox controllers.
controller_xbox_support.ui: 'Enable Steam Input for Xbox controllers' - Settings > Controller

controller_xbox_driver.what: Probably toggles Steam's extended Xbox controller driver (e.g. xpad/xone-style driver support); no JS reference in this build.

controller_switch_support.what: Enables Steam Input for Nintendo Switch Pro controllers.
controller_switch_support.ui: 'Enable Steam Input for Switch Pro controllers' - Settings > Controller

controller_generic_support.what: Enables Steam Input for generic (non-Xbox/PS/Switch) gamepads.
controller_generic_support.ui: 'Enable Steam Input for generic controllers' - Settings > Controller

controller_power_off_timeout.what: Minutes of inactivity before Steam turns off wireless controllers: 5, 10, 15 (default), 30, 60, 120 or Never (stored as 9999).
controller_power_off_timeout.ui: Controller turn-off timeout dropdown - Settings > Controller

turn_off_controller_on_exit.what: Turns off connected controllers when you exit Big Picture Mode.
turn_off_controller_on_exit.ui: 'Turn off controllers when exiting Big Picture Mode' - Settings > Controller

controller_combine_nintendo_joycons.what: Treats a pair of Joy-Cons as one combined controller.
controller_combine_nintendo_joycons.ui: 'Combine Joy-Con Pairs' - Big Picture/Steam Deck QAM > Controller settings

controller_enable_chord.what: Enables Guide-button chord shortcuts (Guide + another button) on controllers (default on).
controller_enable_chord.ui: 'Enable Guide Button Chords for controllers' - Settings > Controller

controller_poll_rate.what: Probably a controller USB/HID polling-rate setting (declared bool but defaults to 2, so likely used as a small enum); no JS reference.

controller_siapi_config_author_mode.what: Steam Input API config author mode: forces new Steam Input API action sets to be shown so developers can author a new configuration.
controller_siapi_config_author_mode.ui: 'Steam Input API Config Author Mode' - Settings > Developer

controller_show_ibex_tour.what: Whether to show the Steam Controller welcome tour (codename 'Ibex') (default on).
controller_show_ibex_tour.ui: 'Show Steam Controller Tour' - Settings > Developer > Miscellaneous

controller_chat_radial_menu_option_0.what: Probably the text/emote for slot 0 of the controller chat radial menu (quick chat messages sent from the in-game chat radial); stored under SteamInput/ChatRadialMenu/0, no direct JS reference by name.
controller_chat_radial_menu_option_0.ui: not shown in UI as a setting (chat radial menu slot)

controller_chat_radial_menu_option_1.what: Probably the text/emote for slot 1 of the controller chat radial menu (quick chat messages sent from the in-game chat radial); stored under SteamInput/ChatRadialMenu/1, no direct JS reference by name.
controller_chat_radial_menu_option_1.ui: not shown in UI as a setting (chat radial menu slot)

controller_chat_radial_menu_option_2.what: Probably the text/emote for slot 2 of the controller chat radial menu (quick chat messages sent from the in-game chat radial); stored under SteamInput/ChatRadialMenu/2, no direct JS reference by name.
controller_chat_radial_menu_option_2.ui: not shown in UI as a setting (chat radial menu slot)

controller_chat_radial_menu_option_3.what: Probably the text/emote for slot 3 of the controller chat radial menu (quick chat messages sent from the in-game chat radial); stored under SteamInput/ChatRadialMenu/3, no direct JS reference by name.
controller_chat_radial_menu_option_3.ui: not shown in UI as a setting (chat radial menu slot)

controller_chat_radial_menu_option_4.what: Probably the text/emote for slot 4 of the controller chat radial menu (quick chat messages sent from the in-game chat radial); stored under SteamInput/ChatRadialMenu/4, no direct JS reference by name.
controller_chat_radial_menu_option_4.ui: not shown in UI as a setting (chat radial menu slot)

controller_chat_radial_menu_option_5.what: Probably the text/emote for slot 5 of the controller chat radial menu (quick chat messages sent from the in-game chat radial); stored under SteamInput/ChatRadialMenu/5, no direct JS reference by name.
controller_chat_radial_menu_option_5.ui: not shown in UI as a setting (chat radial menu slot)

controller_chat_radial_menu_option_6.what: Probably the text/emote for slot 6 of the controller chat radial menu (quick chat messages sent from the in-game chat radial); stored under SteamInput/ChatRadialMenu/6, no direct JS reference by name.
controller_chat_radial_menu_option_6.ui: not shown in UI as a setting (chat radial menu slot)

controller_chat_radial_menu_option_7.what: Probably the text/emote for slot 7 of the controller chat radial menu (quick chat messages sent from the in-game chat radial); stored under SteamInput/ChatRadialMenu/7, no direct JS reference by name.
controller_chat_radial_menu_option_7.ui: not shown in UI as a setting (chat radial menu slot)

startup_movie_id.what: Community item ID of the equipped Big Picture/Steam Deck startup movie (set together with startup_movie_local_path when you equip one).
startup_movie_id.ui: Startup movie picker - Settings > Customization (Big Picture/Steam Deck)

startup_movie_local_path.what: Local file path of the startup movie video to play at boot.

startup_movie_shuffle.what: Plays a random startup movie from your owned movies instead of a fixed one.

startup_movie_used_for_resume.what: Also plays the startup movie when the device resumes from sleep.
startup_movie_used_for_resume.ui: Toggle next to the startup movie options - Settings > Customization

screensaver_current_id.what: ID of the selected screensaver (e.g. a game slideshow/'All Games' screenshots or a downloaded screensaver).

screensaver_settings.what: JSON blob of per-screensaver options (e.g. gameslideshow screenshot source all/general/none).

screensaver_while_ingame.what: Allows the screensaver to start while a game is running (default on).
screensaver_while_ingame.ui: 'Show screensavers when playing a game' - Settings > Customization

game_notes_enable_spellcheck.what: Enables spellcheck in the game notes editor (default on).
game_notes_enable_spellcheck.ui: Spellcheck toggle in the Game Notes editor

screenshot_items_per_row.what: Probably the number of thumbnails per row in the screenshot viewer/manager grid (default 1); no JS reference in this build.

gamerecording_background_path.what: Folder where game recordings (background/manual recordings) are stored; changing it needs a Steam restart.

gamerecording_background_max_keep.what: Background recording length kept on disk, as 'Nmin' or 'infinite' (default '120min'); oldest footage is overwritten once full.
gamerecording_background_max_keep.ui: 'Background recording disk space' / Length - Settings > Game Recording

gamerecording_background_time_resolution.what: Probably the time granularity of background recording segments/timeline in milliseconds (default 60000 = 1 minute); no JS reference.

gamerecording_background_mk.what: Hotkey that adds a timeline marker to the recording (default Ctrl+F12).
gamerecording_background_mk.ui: 'Add a timeline marker' shortcut - Settings > Game Recording > Shortcut Keys

gamerecording_background_tg.what: Hotkey that starts/stops recording (or saving a clip) (default Ctrl+F11).
gamerecording_background_tg.ui: 'Start/stop recording' shortcut - Settings > Game Recording > Shortcut Keys

gamerecording_background_a_m.what: Records your microphone along with gameplay audio.
gamerecording_background_a_m.ui: 'Record Microphone' - Settings > Game Recording > Audio Recording

gamerecording_video_bitrate.what: Recording quality preset string (default 'preset_default' = High); presets Ultra, High, Medium, Low trade quality vs. disk space.

gamerecording_background_mode.what: Game recording mode: 0 Recording Off, 1 Record in Background (always), 2 Record Manually (only after pressing the hotkey).
gamerecording_background_mode.ui: 'Record my games...' mode selector - Settings > Game Recording; also overlay/QAM Game Recording

gamerecording_background_audio.what: Audio sources to record: 0 Game Audio Only, 1 All System Audio, 2 Game and Selected Programs.

gamerecording_hotkey_ic.what: Hotkey that saves the last N seconds (gamerecording_ic_seconds) as an instant clip (unbound by default).
gamerecording_hotkey_ic.ui: 'Save the last N seconds of gameplay as a clip' shortcut - Settings > Game Recording > Shortcut Keys

gamerecording_export_limit_type.what: Remembered export mode in the Export Clip dialog: 0 Original, 1 File Size limit, 2 Custom (resolution/frame rate/bitrate).
gamerecording_export_limit_type.ui: Export Clip dialog limit type (Original / File Size / Custom)

gamerecording_export_limit_size_mb.what: Max file size in MB used by the 'File Size' export mode (default 100).

gamerecording_export_limit_bitrate.what: Bitrate choice remembered for 'Custom' clip export (default 1; options Original/Ultra/High/Medium/Low).

gamerecording_export_limit_width.what: Output width remembered for 'Custom' clip export (default 3840).

gamerecording_export_limit_height.what: Output height remembered for 'Custom' clip export (default 2160; options 720p-4k, never above the source).

gamerecording_export_limit_frame_rate.what: Frame rate remembered for 'Custom' clip export (default 60).

gamerecording_export_directory.what: Last folder used when exporting clips to MP4.

gamerecording_export_codec.what: Codec for exported clips: 0 Default, 1 H.264, 2 H.265 (HEVC).

gamerecording_video_maxheight.what: Maximum recorded video height (0 = native, clamp 0-2160); width follows the game's aspect ratio.

gamerecording_force_mic_mono.what: Records the microphone as mono (fixes mic heard in only one channel).
gamerecording_force_mic_mono.ui: 'Force Microphone to Mono' - Settings > Game Recording

gamerecording_automatic_gain_control.what: Applies automatic gain control to the recorded microphone (default on).

show_timestamps_in_console.what: Prefixes lines in the Steam console with timestamps.
show_timestamps_in_console.ui: 'Show timestamps in Steam console' - Settings > Developer

override_browser_composer_mode.what: Developer override of the browser composer mode; the toggle switches between two enum values (system composer vs. default) and prompts a restart.

cef_remote_debugging_enabled.what: Auto-enables CEF (Chromium) remote debugging of Steam's UI at startup; requires restart.

force_deck_perf_tab.what: Debug: forces the QAM Performance tab to show all Steam Deck settings on other hardware; its UI toggle is compiled out in this build.
force_deck_perf_tab.ui: not shown in UI (developer toggle compiled out)

force_fake_mandatory_update.what: Debug: makes the UI show a mandatory-update gate; applying it clears the flag.

hdr_compat_testing.what: Ignores previously published per-app HDR compatibility information (for testing HDR in games).

developer_mode_enabled.what: Enables Developer Mode, which unlocks the Developer settings page (and other dev features, also exposed to SteamVR).

show_advanced_update_channels.what: Shows additional (advanced) SteamOS update channels in the update channel picker.

browserview_underlays_allowed.what: Allows browser views to use hardware underlays when requirements are met; requires restart.

gamescope_hdr_visualization.what: Gamescope HDR debug visualization: 0 None, 1 Heatmap, 2 Waveform/Color Gamut (Analysis), 3 Heatmap Extended, 4 Heatmap Classic.

gamescope_app_target_framerate.what: Per-game (and per-display) frame limit in FPS that gamescope enforces (0 = default/off); slider values depend on the display's refresh rate.
gamescope_app_target_framerate.ui: 'Frame Limit' slider - Steam Deck/SteamOS QAM > Performance

gamescope_enable_app_target_framerate.what: Enables unified frame limit management, where the frame limit and refresh rate are managed together (default on).
gamescope_enable_app_target_framerate.ui: 'Enable Unified Frame Limit Management' - QAM > Performance (SteamOS)

gamescope_disable_framelimit.what: Per-game: disables the frame limit so the game renders as fast as possible, even above the display refresh rate.

gamescope_display_refresh_rate.what: Per-game/per-display panel refresh rate in Hz used while that game runs (0 = default).

gamescope_use_game_refresh_rate_in_steam.what: Keeps the game's display refresh rate while the Steam UI is shown instead of switching back (default on).
gamescope_use_game_refresh_rate_in_steam.ui: 'Use game display refresh rate in Steam' - Valve Internal/Developer > Display

gamescope_disable_mura_correction.what: Disables the display's mura (panel non-uniformity) compensation on supported SteamOS hardware.

gamescope_include_steamui_in_screenshots.what: Includes Steam UI elements (overlays, QAM etc.) in gamescope screenshots.
gamescope_include_steamui_in_screenshots.ui: 'Include Steam UI elements in screenshots' - Settings > In Game (SteamOS)

gamescope_allow_tearing.what: Per-game: lets the game present unsynchronized with the display (tearing) to reduce latency.

gamescope_composite_debug.what: Gamescope debug option that visualizes compositing (e.g. when gamescope composites vs. scans out directly).

gamescope_force_composite.what: Forces gamescope to always composite frames instead of using direct scanout.

gamescope_game_resolution_global.what: Global default maximum resolution for games under gamescope (string, default 'Default'); per-game resolution overrides take precedence.

gamescope_guide_hotkey.what: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Steam main menu in gamescope sessions (default Shift+Tab).
gamescope_guide_hotkey.ui: 'Main Menu shortcut key(s)' - Settings > In Game (SteamOS)

gamescope_qam_hotkey.what: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Quick Access Menu in gamescope sessions (default Ctrl+Shift+Tab).
gamescope_qam_hotkey.ui: 'Quick Access Menu shortcut key(s)' - Settings > In Game (SteamOS)

gamescope_hdr_enabled.what: Enables HDR output in gamescope (per display, default on).

gamescope_native_external_res_in_steam.what: Runs the Steam UI at the external display's native resolution in gamescope.
gamescope_native_external_res_in_steam.ui: 'Enable Native Resolution on External Displays' - Valve Internal settings (gamescope)

steamos_status_led_brightness.what: Brightness of the device status/power LED, 0-100 (default 100).

steamos_tdp_limit_enabled.what: Per-game: enables a TDP (processor power) limit.

steamos_tdp_limit.what: Per-game TDP limit value in watts (range supplied by the hardware); lower values reduce power draw and performance.

steamos_cec_enabled.what: Enables HDMI-CEC support (control/wake of TVs over HDMI) (default on).

steamos_cec_wake_on_resume.what: Wakes the TV via HDMI-CEC when the device resumes from sleep (default on).
steamos_cec_wake_on_resume.ui: 'Wake TV when device resumes from sleep' - Settings > Display > HDMI-CEC

steamos_wifi_debug.what: Enables Wi-Fi debug data collection on SteamOS.
steamos_wifi_debug.ui: 'Enable Wi-Fi debug data collection' - Settings > Developer (SteamOS)

steamos_wifi_force_wpa_supplicant.what: Forces the wpa_supplicant Wi-Fi backend (instead of the default backend, e.g. iwd) on SteamOS.
steamos_wifi_force_wpa_supplicant.ui: 'Force WPA Supplicant Wi-Fi backend' - Settings > Developer (SteamOS)

steamos_magnifier_scale.what: Zoom level of the screen magnifier, 120-300% in 10% steps (default 150).

steamos_manual_gpu_clock_enabled.what: Per-game: locks the GPU to a fixed clock instead of automatic scaling.

steamos_manual_gpu_clock_hz.what: Per-game fixed GPU clock; despite the 'hz' name the UI shows MHz (step 100, default 1000).

steamos_platform_performance_profile.what: Per-game platform performance profile name (options provided by the hardware/OS, e.g. a power/performance profile).

steamos_charge_limit_enabled.what: Enables a battery charge limit to reduce battery wear.

steamos_charge_limit_devmode.what: Allows the full range of charge limit values (developer option).
steamos_charge_limit_devmode.ui: 'Allow battery limit full range' - Settings > Power/Developer (SteamOS)

steamos_system_tracing_enabled.what: Enables background tracing of CPU/GPU events for performance analysis (per-game).

steamos_vrs_enabled.what: Per-game Half Rate Shading (variable rate shading) that lowers shading quality to save power/improve performance.

steamos_separate_led_colors.what: Allows LED strip colors to be controlled individually rather than as one color (on-disk key is misspelled 'SeparaeLEDColors').
steamos_separate_led_colors.ui: 'Control LED strip colors individually' - Settings > Display/LED (SteamOS)

steamos_wifi_reload_wifi_driver_on_sleep.what: Reloads the Wi-Fi driver around sleep/resume as a workaround for Wi-Fi issues.
steamos_wifi_reload_wifi_driver_on_sleep.ui: 'Reload Wi-Fi driver on sleep' - Settings > Developer (SteamOS)

steamos_wifi_power_management_enabled.what: Enables Wi-Fi power saving (default on); disabling it may improve reliability on 5GHz networks.

steamos_cec_control.what: Accepts TV remote control input via HDMI-CEC (default on).
steamos_cec_control.ui: 'Enable remote control input' - Settings > Display > HDMI-CEC

steamos_cec_suspend_tv.what: Turns the TV off via HDMI-CEC when the device goes to sleep (default on).
steamos_cec_suspend_tv.ui: 'Turn off TV when going to sleep' - Settings > Display > HDMI-CEC

steamos_cec_suspend_device.what: Puts the device to sleep when the TV is turned off (default on).
steamos_cec_suspend_device.ui: 'Sleep when turning off the TV' - Settings > Display > HDMI-CEC

steamos_cec_wake_tv.what: Turns the TV on via HDMI-CEC when the device resumes (default on).
steamos_cec_wake_tv.ui: 'Turn on TV when resuming from sleep' - Settings > Display > HDMI-CEC

steamos_cec_wake_device.what: Resumes the device from sleep when the TV is turned on (default on).
steamos_cec_wake_device.ui: 'Resume from sleep when turning on the TV' - Settings > Display > HDMI-CEC

steamos_ec_logging_enabled.what: Outputs the embedded controller (EC) firmware log to the system journal.

setting_validation_bool.what: Test-only dummy bool field used to exercise the settings pipeline/controls; has no effect on Steam.
setting_validation_bool.ui: GamepadUI 'Settings Zoo' developer test page (/zoo/clientsettings) only

setting_validation_enum.what: Test-only dummy enum field used to exercise the settings pipeline/controls; has no effect on Steam.
setting_validation_enum.ui: GamepadUI 'Settings Zoo' developer test page (/zoo/clientsettings) only

setting_validation_int32.what: Test-only dummy int32 field used to exercise the settings pipeline/controls; has no effect on Steam.
setting_validation_int32.ui: GamepadUI 'Settings Zoo' developer test page (/zoo/clientsettings) only

setting_validation_uint32.what: Test-only dummy uint32 field used to exercise the settings pipeline/controls; has no effect on Steam.
setting_validation_uint32.ui: GamepadUI 'Settings Zoo' developer test page (/zoo/clientsettings) only

setting_validation_uint64.what: Test-only dummy uint64 field used to exercise the settings pipeline/controls; has no effect on Steam.
setting_validation_uint64.ui: GamepadUI 'Settings Zoo' developer test page (/zoo/clientsettings) only

setting_validation_float.what: Test-only dummy float field used to exercise the settings pipeline/controls; has no effect on Steam.
setting_validation_float.ui: GamepadUI 'Settings Zoo' developer test page (/zoo/clientsettings) only

setting_validation_string.what: Test-only dummy string field used to exercise the settings pipeline/controls; has no effect on Steam.
setting_validation_string.ui: GamepadUI 'Settings Zoo' developer test page (/zoo/clientsettings) only

setting_validation_hotkey.what: Test-only dummy hotkey field used to exercise the settings pipeline/controls; has no effect on Steam.
setting_validation_hotkey.ui: GamepadUI 'Settings Zoo' developer test page (/zoo/clientsettings) only

system_bluetooth_enabled.what: Turns Bluetooth on or off on SteamOS devices (enabled automatically during setup when the service is available).

hardware_updater_enabled.what: Enables the hardware (firmware) updater; requires restart.

system_idle_suspend_battery_sec.what: Seconds of idle on battery before the device sleeps (default 900 = 15 min).
system_idle_suspend_battery_sec.ui: 'Sleep after' (When On Battery and Idle) - Settings > Power (SteamOS)

system_idle_suspend_ac_sec.what: Seconds of idle while plugged in before the device sleeps (default 3600 = 1 h).
system_idle_suspend_ac_sec.ui: 'Sleep after' (When Plugged In and Idle) - Settings > Power (SteamOS)

system_enable_low_power_downloads.what: Lets downloads finish in a low-power, display-off state when the device sleeps (default on).
system_enable_low_power_downloads.ui: 'Finish downloads with display off before sleeping' - Settings > Power (SteamOS)

system_allow_battery_low_power_downloads.what: Allows display-off downloads on battery; the device sleeps if battery falls below 20%.
system_allow_battery_low_power_downloads.ui: 'Enable display-off downloads on battery power' - Settings > Power (SteamOS)

system_idle_screensaver_battery_sec.what: Seconds of idle on battery before the screensaver starts (default 0 = off).

system_idle_screensaver_ac_sec.what: Seconds of idle while plugged in before the screensaver starts (default 300 = 5 min).
system_idle_screensaver_ac_sec.ui: 'Start screensaver after' / 'When idle, start screensaver after' - Settings > Power / Customization

vr_show_perf_graph_in_hmd.what: Probably shows the SteamVR performance (frame timing) graph inside the headset; no JS reference in this build.

accessibility_debug_visualizer.what: Developer visualizer that highlights accessibility (screen reader) information in the UI.
accessibility_debug_visualizer.ui: 'Enable Accessibility Debug Visualizer' - Valve Internal > Accessibility

accessibility_screen_reader_enabled.what: Enables the Steam UI screen reader.

accessibility_screen_reader_rate.what: Screen reader speech rate, 0-1 (step 0.05, default 0.5). Note: stored on disk under the key 'ScreenReaderPitch' (keys swapped with pitch).

accessibility_screen_reader_pitch.what: Screen reader voice pitch, 0-1 (step 0.05, default 0.5). Stored on disk under 'ScreenReaderRate'.

accessibility_high_contrast_mode.what: Makes Steam text, buttons and icons more distinct from the background.

accessibility_reduce_motion.what: Disables certain Steam animations, effects and transitions.

accessibility_minimum_font_size.what: Minimum font size for Steam UI text, 8-24 (0 = off/default).
accessibility_minimum_font_size.ui: 'Minimum Font Size' slider (unlocalized label, probably dev/internal) - Accessibility

accessibility_color_filter_name.what: Name of the color filter (e.g. color-blindness filter) applied to the display in-game and in Steam; '' = none.

accessibility_desktop_ui_scale.what: Desktop Steam UI scale factor (default 1; slider from 0.5 with Smaller/Larger text notches).

accessibility_screen_reader_locale.what: Language/voice used by the screen reader ('auto' = follow Steam language).

accessibility_mono_audio.what: Probably mixes audio down to mono for accessibility; no JS reference in this build.

remote_play_wifi_ap_enabled.what: Enables the Wireless Streaming Adapter (Steam Frame) access point used for Remote Play to the headset (default on).
remote_play_wifi_ap_enabled.ui: 'Wireless Streaming Adapter (Steam Frame)' section - Settings > Remote Play

remote_play_wifi_ap_channel_5ghz.what: Wi-Fi channel for the adapter's 5GHz operation (0 = Auto).

remote_play_wifi_ap_channel_6ghz.what: Wi-Fi channel for the adapter's 6GHz operation (0 = Auto).

remote_play_wifi_ap_channel_width.what: Wi-Fi channel width for the adapter: Auto (0), 80 MHz or 160 MHz.

remote_play_wifi_ap_hotspot_mode.what: Connection Management: Steam (false, default) or Custom (true), where the HMD acts as a Wi-Fi hotspot you connect to manually.

remote_play_wifi_ap_hotspot_password.what: Password of the custom hotspot (stored in plain text in config.vdf).

remote_play_wifi_ap_hotspot_routing.what: Internet access for hotspot clients: 'noroute' = None (streaming only, default) or NAT via the HMD's Wi-Fi.
remote_play_wifi_ap_hotspot_routing.ui: 'Hotspot Client Internet' - Settings > Remote Play (Custom mode)

remote_play_wifi_ap_show_advanced.what: Shows the advanced Wi-Fi settings (channels/width) for the streaming adapter.
remote_play_wifi_ap_show_advanced.ui: 'Show Advanced Wi-Fi Settings' - Settings > Remote Play

remote_play_wifi_ap_paired_ssid.what: SSID of the Wireless Streaming Adapter this device is paired to (state, used for the Pair/Unpair UI).

skip_steamframe_pairing_dialog.what: Suppresses the Steam Frame wireless adapter pairing dialog.
skip_steamframe_pairing_dialog.ui: 'Don't show again' on the Steam Frame adapter pairing dialog

skip_steamframe_troubleshooting_dialog.what: Suppresses the Steam Frame wireless adapter troubleshooting dialog.
skip_steamframe_troubleshooting_dialog.ui: 'Don't show this dialog again' on the adapter troubleshooting dialog

skip_steamframe_airplane_dialog.what: Suppresses the Steam Frame wireless adapter airplane-mode dialog.
skip_steamframe_airplane_dialog.ui: 'Don't show this dialog again' on the adapter airplane-mode dialog

oobe_completed.what: State: true once stage 1 of the out-of-box experience (first-run setup) is done, or on platforms without OOBE.

oobe_test_mode_enabled.what: Read-only: OOBE test mode, enabled by -testoobe or force_oobe; completion is then tracked in memory only.

force_oobe.what: Forces the out-of-box (first-run) experience on every device start.

oobe_stage_2_completed.what: State: true once OOBE stage 2 is completed, or on platforms without OOBE.

oobe_stage_2_test_mode_enabled.what: Read-only: OOBE stage-2 test mode, enabled by -testoobe or force_stage_2_oobe.

force_stage_2_oobe.what: Forces OOBE stage 2 on every device start.

compat_show_all_tools.what: Lists all compatibility tools (e.g. every Proton version) in Steam Play/compatibility choosers.
